name: TrustDemoTaifafekiVhlReceipt
title: Taifafeki: record of a summary read through a VHL
description:
How it is used: J4.1. The Kesaro clinic viewer keeps this record when it opens Somsak's patient summary through the Verifiable Health Link that his father shows.

Why: the Taifafeki clinic views the record from Onesa and does not copy it into any registry in Taifafeki. So the clinic keeps a note of what it saw, where it came from, and how it was verified: the VHL's signature against the key of Onesa on the GDHCN trust list, the manifest fetch, and the passcode. Onesa keeps its own log of the same access (the audit profile of Onesa).
